overview: The day was dominated by SpaceX's Starship Flight 15: Ship 42 was caught by the tower arms for the first time, though the booster was lost after running slightly low on fuel. On the AI side, Dwarkesh Patel argued AI research may soon automate itself, Patrick Collison questioned what a post-work society looks like, and Musk pushed Grok Bot's new phone-call feature. The Jensen Huang controversy kept rippling through tech accounts.

top_items.title: elonmusk - Starship Ship 42 caught by tower arms after a 22+ hour, ~14-orbit flight, a first for the upper stage
elonmusk - Flight 15 booster was lost after slight engine underperformance; Musk says Raptor V3.2 and earlier MECO1 will fix it
dwarkesh_sp - Argues AI research is a verifiable domain, so a GPT-3-to-GPT-6-sized jump could fit in one year within months to years
elonmusk - Promotes Grok Bot's new phone-call feature, citing a user whose bot rebooked a cancelled flight plus hotel and meals
JTLonsdale - On the Jensen Huang fallout, warns a government ban on open-source models could enable censorship
patrickc - Stripe's Collison asks AI optimists to explain how a post-work society still produces the next Mozart or Dickens
demishassabis - Shares first Gemini 4 Hydrogen coding results on 2 real repos with 105 replanted bugs to find and fix
